name: uap-mcp
description: Unity Asset Manager, Asset Transformer, and Pipeline Automation MCP servers + skills.

AT_LICENSE_SERVER_HOST.title: Asset Transformer license server host
AT_LICENSE_SERVER_HOST.description: Hostname of the Pixyz license server.

AT_LICENSE_SERVER_PORT.title: Asset Transformer license server port
AT_LICENSE_SERVER_PORT.description: Port of the Pixyz FlexLM license server.

AT_LICENSE_TOKENS.title: Asset Transformer extra license tokens
AT_LICENSE_TOKENS.description: Optional comma-separated Pixyz feature tokens to acquire in addition to the mandatory product token (e.g. 'TokenA,TokenB'). Leave blank to acquire only what the built-in tools need (recommended — extra tokens consume more of your license pool).

AT_LICENSE_FAIL_FAST.title: Asset Transformer license fail-fast
AT_LICENSE_FAIL_FAST.description: Validate license-server connectivity at server startup (a seat is briefly acquired and immediately released) and refuse to start if no license is available. Default off: fully lazy — a seat is only acquired when the first Asset Transformer tool runs.

AT_MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS.title: Asset Transformer max concurrent jobs
AT_MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS.description: Maximum number of heavy Asset Transformer operations (import, prepare, optimise, export, render, bake) allowed to run at the same time in this server, so limited license seats/machines are not overwhelmed. Set 0 for unlimited.

AT_DISABLE_RUN_PYTHON.title: Disable the Asset Transformer run_python tool
AT_DISABLE_RUN_PYTHON.description: Do not offer the run_python tool at all. It executes arbitrary Python inside the Asset Transformer process by design (the at-scripting workflow depends on it), so it is available by default; turn it off on shared or CI machines where nothing should be able to run code as this user. The scene, import, optimise, render and export tools are unaffected.

AT_MAX_IMPORT_BYTES.title: Asset Transformer maximum import size (bytes)
AT_MAX_IMPORT_BYTES.description: Refuse to hand a file larger than this to the CAD importer. 0 (default) means no limit, because real CAD assemblies are legitimately many gigabytes. Set a ceiling on shared or CI machines, where one oversized import affects other people.

UAP_MCP_ALLOWED_ROOTS.title: Restrict file access to these directories
UAP_MCP_ALLOWED_ROOTS.description: Optional list of directories (separated by ';' on Windows, ':' elsewhere) that every local file the servers read or write must sit inside — uploads, downloads, exports, screenshots and CAD imports. Leave blank (default) to allow any location except credential stores and auto-executed startup files, which are always refused.

UNITY_VPC_FQDN.title: Private cloud (VPC) host
UNITY_VPC_FQDN.description: Hostname of your Unity private cloud deployment (e.g. private-cloud.example.com). Leave blank for standard public Unity Cloud. When set, Asset Manager and Pipeline Automation talk to your deployment and sign-in uses its identity service instead of Unity ID.

UNITY_VPC_PATH_PREFIX.title: Private cloud path prefix
UNITY_VPC_PATH_PREFIX.description: Path prefix in front of the service paths on your private cloud ingress — commonly 'backend' (giving https://<host>/backend/assets/v1/...). Leave blank if the services are served at the host root.

UNITY_VPC_OPENID_CONFIG_URL.title: Private cloud OpenID configuration URL
UNITY_VPC_OPENID_CONFIG_URL.description: Optional override for the deployment's OpenID Connect discovery URL. Leave blank to use the standard location (https://<host>/auth/realms/unity/.well-known/openid-configuration).

UNITY_VPC_CLIENT_ID.title: Private cloud OAuth client id
UNITY_VPC_CLIENT_ID.description: Public OAuth client used for the browser sign-in on your private cloud. Defaults to 'dashboard'.

UNITY_VPC_AUTOMATION_PATH.title: Private cloud Pipeline Automation service path
UNITY_VPC_AUTOMATION_PATH.description: Service path for Pipeline Automation on your private cloud, relative to the host and prefix. Leave blank to auto-detect: 'api/automation/v1' is tried first (newer private-cloud bundles), then 'api/automation/v1alpha1' (older bundles). Set explicitly only if your deployment serves it elsewhere.

UNITY_VPC_ASSETS_PATH.title: Private cloud Asset Manager service path
UNITY_VPC_ASSETS_PATH.description: Service path for Asset Manager on your private cloud, relative to the host and prefix. Defaults to 'assets/v1'.
